arabic text: TAPTI HUWI REHTI PE HAYE TUKRE BADAN HAI\nPEHCHAANO MUSALMANO – YE AWLAADE HASAN HAI
english translation text: ON THE HOT SANDS LIES THE PIECES OF THE BODY\nRECOGNISE OH MUSLIMS\nTHIS IS THE SON OF HASSAN

arabic text: ARMAAN THA SHADI KA TUJHE DULHA BANANE KA\nAFSOS KE AB MA KE HAATHON ME KAFAN HAI
english translation text: I HAD A DESIRE TO GET YOU MARRIED\nALAS I AM INSTEAD HOLDING A KAFAN IN MY HAND

arabic text: DOWRAYE GAYE GORE MASOOM KE LAASHE PE\nBIKHRA HUWA KARBAL ME QASIM TERA TAN HAI
english translation text: THE HORSES TRAMPLED THE BODY OF THE INNOCENT\nQASIM YOUR BODY IS SCATTERED OVER KARBALA

arabic text: BETA HAI KAHAAN TU AB AAWAAZ MUJHE DENA\nTUKRON KO JAMAA KARTA HAYE SHAHE ZAMAN HAI
english translation text: IMAM HUSSAYN SAID AS HE GATHERED QASIM'S BODY\nWHERE ARE YOU SON? PLEASE CALL OUT TO ME

arabic text: QURBANI HASAN TERI KAAM AGAYI IS DEEN KE\nAALE NABI KE SADQE YE DEEN JO ROSHAN HAI
english translation text: OH HASSAN YOUR SACRIFICE GIVEN\nIN THE WAY OF AALE NABI WILL HELP SAVE THE RELIGION
